services.name: School groups
services.desc: The Nassau County Museum of Art is located on the former 145-acre estate of the Frick family, who lived here from 1919 to 1965. Today, NCMA, a nationally landmarked historic home, serves as a fine art gallery featuring three exhibitions a year, a sculpture garden with over 40 large-scale works, as well as an arboretum with hiking trails throughout. We invite school children of all ages for guided visits to the museum for the changing exhibitions, as well as the opportunity to explore the natural surroundings and sculpture garden.
